site.name: forge-coder
site.summary: Forge Coder — agentic coding IDE (local demo) Fictional agentic coding product. Local fixture for UXBench. Open `index.html` directly. Page `index.html` — Agent run view Three-pane IDE-style layout: file tree (left) + agent chat (center) + live diff preview (right). Left — file tree: - Virtual TypeScript project (`atlas-cli`) with folder collapse, file-status badges (M for modified, + for newly added), and a summary footer. - Clicking any file marked M / + loads its diff into the right pane.

explored_user_goal: Autonomously explore and critique the UX of the full forge-coder system, prioritizing the primary chatbot/agent interface flow plus adjacent pages, states, and recovery paths.
exploration_summary: The Forge Coder interface has several UX issues, including unresponsive file tree interactions, missing feedback for critical actions like 'Accept all changes' and 'Rerun', and small tap targets on mobile. Coverage is partial, with 26 failed actions and 44% unchanged actions, indicating potential dead controls or untested paths.

exploration_plan.goal: Explore and critique the UX of the forge-coder agentic coding interface, focusing on the primary chatbot interaction flow, file tree navigation, and adjacent states/controls.
exploration_plan.summary: The run will start on index.html, first validating the chatbot interaction flow (typing, sending, and observing agent responses). Then, it will explore file tree navigation (clicking M/+ files, folder expansion), top navigation (Agent/Inbox/Runs/Settings), and key controls (Interrupt, Rerun, Accept changes). Finally, it will check mobile viewport layout and small tap targets.
assumptions: The site has only one HTML page (index.html) with all functionality.
Small tap targets may cause usability issues on mobile.
risk_hotspots: Small tap targets (e.g., Agent, Inbox, ⌕ buttons)
Chatbot interaction flow (typing, sending, response handling)

phases.title: Chatbot Interaction Flow
phases.objective: Validate the chatbot input, send, and response handling.
key_checks: Type text into the chat input (textarea)
Click 'Send' button and observe agent response
Check if 'Auto-apply edits' checkbox works (state change)
exit_criteria: Chat input accepts text, 'Send' triggers response, 'Auto-apply edits' toggles state.

phases.title: File Tree Navigation
phases.objective: Validate file tree expansion, M/+ file clicks, and diff preview.
key_checks: Click a 'M' (modified) file (e.g., stream.ts, chunker.ts) and check diff preview
Click a '+' (added) file (e.g., index.ts) and check diff preview
Expand/collapse a folder (e.g., src/upload) and verify state change
exit_criteria: M/+ files load diffs, folders expand/collapse correctly.

phases.title: Top Navigation & Controls
phases.objective: Validate top navigation (Agent, Inbox, Runs, Settings) and key buttons (Interrupt, Rerun, Connect a repo).
key_checks: Click 'Connect a repo' and 'Open in VS Code' buttons (check visual feedback)
exit_criteria: Top navigation links change state, Interrupt/Rerun/Connect buttons show feedback.

phases.title: Mobile Viewport Checks
phases.objective: Validate layout and key interactions in mobile viewport.
key_checks: Check small tap targets (e.g., Agent, Inbox, ⌕ buttons) for usability
Re-run key checks (chat input, file tree, top navigation) in mobile view
exit_criteria: Key interactions work in mobile view, small tap targets are usable (or warnings are confirmed).

phases.title: Other Controls (Unified/Split, Open Editor, Accept All)
phases.objective: Validate 'Unified/Split' diff view, 'Open editor', and 'Accept all changes' buttons.
key_checks: Click 'Unified' and 'Split' buttons (check diff view change)
Click 'Open editor' and 'Accept all changes' buttons (check visual feedback)
exit_criteria: 'Unified/Split' toggles diff view, 'Open editor'/'Accept all changes' show feedback.

coverage_targets.features: Exercise chatbot, file tree, top navigation, key buttons (Interrupt, Rerun, Send, etc.)
coverage_targets.mobile: Repeat critical checks (chat, file tree, top navigation) in mobile viewport

notes: Max steps (80) should be sufficient for exhaustive exploration of the single page with multiple controls.

findings.user_goal: Load diff preview for modified/added files in the file tree
findings.problem: Clicking modified/added files (e.g., 'stream.ts', 'index.ts') in the file tree failed to load their diff previews, with timeouts and no UI updates.
findings.evidence: Multiple click actions on 'stream.ts' (ux-18) and 'index.ts' (ux-19) failed due to timeouts, and the diff pane remained unchanged (e.g., showing 'chunker.ts' changes instead).
findings.why_it_matters: Users can’t review code changes for specific files, blocking the core workflow of validating agent-generated edits.
findings.suggestion: Fix file tree interaction logic to ensure clicks on modified/added files load their diffs. Add loading states or error messages for failed interactions.

findings.problem: Clicking 'Accept all changes' provided no visible feedback (e.g., diff updates, file status badge changes) to confirm edits were applied.
findings.evidence: After clicking 'Accept all changes', the diff pane and file tree badges (M/+) remained unchanged, with no UI updates to indicate success or failure.
findings.why_it_matters: Users can’t trust the action worked, leading to uncertainty about code state and potential rework.
findings.suggestion: Add visual feedback (e.g., diff pane updates, badge removal, success message) when 'Accept all changes' is successful. Log errors if the action fails.

findings.user_goal: Rerun the agent to generate new code changes
findings.problem: Clicking 'Rerun' (desktop and mobile) provided no visible feedback (e.g., run status updates, button state changes) to confirm the action was triggered.
findings.evidence: Multiple 'Rerun' clicks (ux-10) failed to update the run status (remained 'paused'), button appearance, or chat content, with no UI changes detected.
findings.why_it_matters: Users can’t tell if the rerun started, blocking iteration on code requests and wasting time.
findings.suggestion: Add visual feedback (e.g., run status updates, button color/text changes, loading spinner) when 'Rerun' is triggered. Ensure the action initiates a new run process.

findings.user_goal: Interact with small tap targets on mobile
findings.problem: Many mobile tap targets (e.g., navigation links, buttons) are smaller than 44x44px (e.g., 'Agent' link: 56x32px, 'Inbox' link: 53x32px), violating mobile accessibility guidelines.
findings.evidence: Layout warnings show multiple tap targets (e.g., 'Agent', 'Inbox', '⌕' button) have dimensions below 44px, leading to accidental taps or missed interactions.
findings.why_it_matters: Mobile users struggle to interact with controls, reducing efficiency and increasing error rates.
findings.suggestion: Increase tap target sizes to at least 44x44px. Adjust spacing or styling to ensure all interactive elements meet accessibility standards.
findings.source_hint: index.html: mobile viewport interactables (e.g., ux-1, ux-2, ux-7)

findings.problem: The 'Rerun' button provided no visual feedback (e.g., color change, loading state) when clicked, even after multiple attempts.
findings.evidence: After multiple clicks on 'Rerun' (ux-10), the button’s appearance and run status (e.g., 'paused') remained unchanged, with no UI updates to indicate the action was processed.
findings.why_it_matters: Users can’t determine if the rerun is in progress, leading to confusion and potential duplicate actions.
findings.suggestion: Add a loading state (e.g., spinner, color change) to the 'Rerun' button when clicked, and update the run status (e.g., 'running') to confirm the action is triggered.

findings.user_goal: Confirm '+' button in file tree creates a new file
findings.problem: Clicking the '+' button in the file tree header provided no visible feedback (e.g., new file, modal, confirmation) to indicate the action was triggered.
findings.evidence: After clicking the '+' button (ux-8), the file tree remained unchanged, with no new files, modals, or messages appearing.
findings.why_it_matters: Users can’t tell if the action worked, leading to uncertainty about file creation and potential repeated clicks.
findings.suggestion: Add visual feedback (e.g., new file in tree, modal, success message) when the '+' button is clicked. If it’s non-functional, disable it or show a tooltip explaining its purpose.

findings.user_goal: Interact with 'Open in VS Code' button on mobile
findings.problem: Clicking 'Open in VS Code' on mobile provided no visible feedback (e.g., color change, loading state) to confirm the action was triggered.
findings.evidence: After clicking 'Open in VS Code' (ux-6), the button’s appearance and UI remained unchanged, with no indication of success or failure.
findings.why_it_matters: Mobile users can’t confirm if the action (e.g., opening VS Code) was initiated, leading to uncertainty and potential repeated actions.
findings.suggestion: Add visual feedback (e.g., color change, loading spinner) when 'Open in VS Code' is clicked. Log errors if the action fails (e.g., VS Code not installed).

findings.user_goal: Switch to 'Inbox' view via top navigation
findings.problem: Clicking the 'Inbox' link in the top navigation provided no visible feedback (e.g., state change, UI update) to confirm the view switched.
findings.evidence: After clicking 'Inbox', the URL and UI remained unchanged, with no visual indication (e.g., highlight, content update) that the view switched to 'Inbox'.
findings.why_it_matters: Users can’t tell if the action worked, leading to confusion about the current view and potential repeated clicks.
findings.suggestion: Add visual feedback (e.g., highlight, URL update, content change) when 'Inbox' is clicked. Ensure the view switches to the 'Inbox' interface.

gaps: 26 browser action(s) failed and should be retried or analyzed.
